findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_venture_chart_of_the_day, search_charts, get_mode_vc_thesis_and_criteria · Private data: get_new_raises, get_firm_filings, get_daily_ai_raises · Public sink: calc_safe_dilution, calc_fundraising_readiness.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_venture_chart_of_the_day, search_charts, get_mode_vc_thesis_and_criteria · Private data: get_new_raises, get_firm_filings, get_daily_ai_raises · Public sink: calc_safe_dilution, calc_fundraising_readiness

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
